privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: A space for stories, music, and connection—with clarity about your information.
sections: Who this notice covers

This notice describes The Sound of Becoming website, presented by Brand Misfit™ Media and coordinated by Charlene Brown of Bklyn Custom Designs®. It applies to this GitHub Pages website. Separate websites, event platforms, music services and download providers have their own privacy practices.
Browsing and listening

You can browse this site without creating an account or submitting personal information. The site itself currently has no sign-up forms, advertising trackers, analytics scripts or marketing cookies. Audio samples, when added, are served as media files from the website; playback does not automatically open a music-service account or subscribe you to anything.
Hosting information

GitHub hosts this website. GitHub states that visitors’ IP addresses are logged and stored for security purposes, including when visitors are not signed in to GitHub. Its privacy statement describes how GitHub handles information collected through its services. See GitHub’s privacy statement.
Controls and preferences

The motion control, album discovery feature and sample players work within the current page. We do not save those interactions in cookies or browser storage, and we do not use them to build a listener profile.
Links, redirects and downloads

Album buttons lead to independent music platforms through Bklyn Custom Designs® short links. Other buttons may lead to artist websites, social platforms, Google Drive downloads or the event invitation. When you follow those links, the destination and any redirect service may receive technical information and apply their own cookies, logging and account policies. These services are not covered by this notice. We do not receive your streaming-service password or payment details through this website.
If you contact us

If you choose to email a contributor or contact the organizer, the recipient receives the information you send and may use it to respond to your request, coordinate the event or discuss a proposed collaboration or music permission. Send only information needed for your request. Contributor contact destinations are identified on their pages; information sent directly to them is handled by those recipients.
Questions, requests and updates

For privacy questions or requests concerning information you supplied to the event organizer, use the contact options at Bklyn Custom Designs® and identify The Sound of Becoming. Contact a third-party provider directly for information it holds. We will consider requests as applicable and may need to verify them. This notice will be updated if the website’s information practices change.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: Enjoy the circle. Respect the stories and the people who created them.
sections: About this website

The Sound of Becoming presents music, biographies, stories, event information and links from five songwriters, alongside our event producer. Brand Misfit™ Media presents the event; Charlene Brown of Bklyn Custom Designs® is its Creative Director and Executive Producer. These terms describe the permitted use of the website and its materials.
Personal listening and reading

You may browse the pages, listen using the provided players, follow official album links, and download the program and keepsake where a download is offered for your personal, noncommercial reference. This limited permission does not grant a license to reuse the music or publish, distribute or sell the materials. You may share links to official pages instead of copying or re-uploading their contents.
The creators retain their rights

The featured women retain their respective rights in their music, lyrics, stories and original contributions. Other credited contributors and rights holders retain their respective rights. Publication on this website does not transfer ownership to visitors or create a blanket license. See our Music rights + permissions page for reuse requests.
Use that requires permission

Do not reproduce, re-upload, distribute, sample, remix, adapt, license, sell or use the music or other protected materials in commercial projects without explicit prior written permission from the relevant rights holder(s), unless a valid existing license or applicable law authorizes the particular use. This includes advertising, promotional films, monetized content, podcasts, paid courses and brand campaigns. Credit alone is not permission.
Respectful access

Do not interfere with the site, bypass access controls, misrepresent a relationship with a contributor, remove rights notices, or imply endorsement of a product or service without authorization. A publicly accessible sample is provided for listening and discovery; accessibility does not make it public-domain material.
Outside services and availability

Music platforms, social profiles, invitation services, redirects and downloads are provided for convenience. Their availability, prices, account requirements and policies are controlled by their providers. Event details and website content may be updated. We do not guarantee uninterrupted access or that every external link will remain available in every region.
Legal rights and contact

Nothing in these terms removes rights or exceptions provided by applicable law, including fair use where it applies. To raise a website issue or ask where to direct a permissions request, use the contact options at Bklyn Custom Designs® and name the relevant contributor and work. Contacting the organizer does not itself grant permission or establish that the organizer can license every contribution.

music-rights.title: Music rights + permissions
music-rights.intro: Their words. Their music. Their rights.
sections: Ownership stays with the creators

Charlene Brown, Shirley Ann Felder, Clavia Allen, Marcy Trueheart and Karon Fayerweather retain their respective rights in the music, lyrics, stories and original material they contribute. Credited collaborators and other rights holders retain their respective rights as applicable. Brand Misfit™ Media presents this collection; presentation does not consolidate all contributors’ rights under one owner.
Written permission comes first

No reproduction, redistribution, re-uploading, sampling, remixing, adaptation or commercial use of protected music or materials is authorized by this website. Obtain explicit prior written permission from the relevant woman or women and any other necessary rights holder(s) before proceeding, unless your specific use is already authorized by a valid license or applicable law.
Commercial projects

Permission is required where applicable for use in advertisements, sponsored or monetized posts, promotional videos, films, podcasts, paid programs, products, client projects, brand campaigns and other business or revenue-generating uses. A short excerpt, a purchase, a stream, event attendance or a download does not by itself grant those rights. Giving credit does not replace permission.
A song and its recording can involve different rights

The underlying song—including its music and lyrics—and a particular sound recording are separate works. Your project may need clearance for both, and permission from more than one party. Permission must cover the specific recording, purpose, platforms, territory and duration of your use. Learn more from the U.S. Copyright Office.
How to request permission

Start with the songwriter’s contact link on her profile. Include the song title, the recording or version, the excerpt and length, a description of your project, the intended platforms and audience, whether it is paid or monetized, the territory, the duration of use and the proposed release date. For help identifying the right contact, use Bklyn Custom Designs®. The organizer can help route an inquiry; it is not an automatic licensing agent for every work. Wait for the necessary written authorization before using the material. No response is not consent.
Photos, stories and branding

Headshots, biographies, purpose statements, artwork, event graphics, logos and other protected contributions also remain subject to their owners’ rights. Do not use a woman’s name, image or brand to suggest her endorsement without authorization. Sanah Bittaye Mitchell retains her respective rights in her biography, image and original contributions; her appearance here is not an album credit or music license.
Permitted access and legal exceptions

You are welcome to listen through the provided players, visit official platforms and share official page links. The program and keepsake are offered for personal, noncommercial reference where a download is provided. Nothing on this page overrides applicable legal exceptions, statutory licenses or permissions you already validly hold. This notice grants no additional reuse rights.
